home.hero.title.id: Foto dan video pernikahan, acara, dan brand di Bali.
home.hero.title.en: Wedding, event and brand shoots in Bali.

home.hero.copy.id: Tim kecil, produksi lengkap, dari obrolan pertama sampai file terakhir. Kirim tanggalnya, kami langsung kabari kosong atau tidak.
home.hero.copy.en: Small crew, full production, from the first call to the final file. Send us a date and we will tell you straight away whether it is open.

home.about.title.id: Tim foto dan video di Denpasar
home.about.title.en: A photo and video team in Denpasar

home.about.copy.id: MellogangVisuals adalah tim foto dan video yang berbasis di Denpasar. Sebagian besar kerjaan kami pernikahan dan acara di sekitar Bali, ditambah proyek korporat dan destinasi kalau briefnya cocok.
home.about.copy.en: MellogangVisuals is a photo and video team based in Denpasar. Most of our work is weddings and events around Bali, plus corporate and destination projects when the brief fits.

home.about.image.alt.id: Peserta acara budaya di ruang terbuka, Bali
home.about.image.alt.en: Participants at an outdoor cultural event in Bali

home.cta.copy.id: Kirim ke kami sekalian gambaran acaranya. Biasanya kami balas dalam sehari.
home.cta.copy.en: Send it over with a rough idea of the day. We usually reply within a day.

about.hero.title.id: Kerja kami dan cara kami mengerjakannya
about.hero.title.en: What we do, and how we do it

about.hero.copy.id: MellogangVisuals berbasis di Denpasar. Kami mengerjakan pernikahan, prewedding, acara, video korporat, dan promosi destinasi. Kru kami kecil, dan untuk acara besar kami menambah orang.
about.hero.copy.en: MellogangVisuals is based in Denpasar. We shoot weddings, prewedding sessions, events, corporate video and destination promos. The crew is small, and we add people when the event is big.

about.work.copy1.id: Paling sering pernikahan dan acara di Bali. Sisanya video korporat, profil perusahaan, dan promosi hotel atau destinasi. Proyek di luar Bali tetap kami terima, biaya perjalanan dihitung terpisah.
about.work.copy1.en: Most of it is weddings and events in Bali. The rest is corporate video, company profiles, and hotel or destination promos. We take work outside Bali too; travel is quoted separately.

about.work.copy2.id: Kalau tanggal kamu bentrok dengan booking lain, kami bilang dari awal. Kami tidak menahan tanggal tanpa kepastian.
about.work.copy2.en: If your date clashes with another booking, we say so at the start. We do not hold a date without confirming it.

about.work.image.alt.id: Peserta acara budaya di ruang terbuka, Bali
about.work.image.alt.en: Participants at an outdoor cultural event in Bali

about.stages.before.copy.id: Kami bahas lingkup kerja, referensi, dan timeline. Kalau lokasinya memungkinkan, kami survei dulu sebelum hari H.
about.stages.before.copy.en: We agree the scope, the references and the timeline. If the location allows it, we survey it before the day.

about.stages.during.copy.id: Kru datang sudah hafal rundown. Kami menyesuaikan diri dengan jalannya acara, bukan sebaliknya.
about.stages.during.copy.en: The crew arrives knowing the run-down. We work around the event, not the other way round.

about.stages.after.copy.id: Seleksi, editing, dan colour. File akhir dikirim lewat Google Drive pada tanggal yang sudah disepakati.
about.stages.after.copy.en: Selection, editing and colour. The final files go out on the agreed date, via Google Drive.

about.cta.title.en: Send us a date and a rough outline

about.cta.copy.id: Kami balas dengan status tanggalnya dan perkiraan biaya.
about.cta.copy.en: We reply with the status of that date and a price estimate.

portfolio.hero.copy.id: Film promosi, prewedding, dokumentasi acara, dan video korporat dari 2022 sampai 2024. Buka satu proyek untuk menonton filmnya.
portfolio.hero.copy.en: Promotional films, prewedding sessions, event coverage and corporate video from 2022 to 2024. Open a project to watch the film.

portfolio.cta.copy.en: Send the date and the location and we will reply with availability.

book.intro.copy.id: Jenis proyek, tanggal, dan lokasi sudah cukup buat kami cek ketersediaan. Sisanya bisa dibahas di WhatsApp.
book.intro.copy.en: Project type, date and location are enough for us to check availability. The rest can be sorted out on WhatsApp.

book.intro.aside.copy.en: If it is urgent, message us on WhatsApp.

book.form.date.hint.id: Belum pasti juga tidak apa-apa. Tulis perkiraan terdekat.
